text:
mel: OK team — final pre-launch check. We go into the quiet window at 22:00 UTC. I need: pin confirmations, rollback owners, and who takes smoke tests. Quick replies please. :alarm_clock:

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary pin status: v3.4.1-canary -> pinned on canary pool 3. Canary health: 98% (latency p95 210ms). Auto-scaling: enabled. :white_check_mark:

chris: I can own rollback for API layer. If errors > 5% for 5m we cut traffic and revert to v3.4.0. Who owns model fallback?

ana: @mel i'm taking model fallback (route -> small-quantized) and will watch quality metrics. Will stand by for 22:00.

ana: confirm pin: v3.4.1 -> pinned in prod routing table at 21:50 UTC.

mel: noted. chris -> API rollback. ana -> model fallback. who does smoke on eu region?

lisa: I’ll do EU smoke, 22:05 UTC. checklist: login, endpoint /v1/generate short prompt, embeddings sanity for 5 items. Posting quick script: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"smoke test"}'```

joel: Release notes pushed: https://go/release/notes/3.4.1 — includes canary observations, quant flag changes, and the fallback plan. Also added rollback runbook link.

sre-ops: Rollback owners and comms:
- chris (API) -> run `./scripts/traffic-revert api v3.4.0` and notify #incidents
- ana (models) -> set routing flag `model_variant=small-quant` and run `deploy-bot rollback-model canary->fallback`
- lisa (region smoke) -> confirm success/failure in thread and tag oncall

sre-ops: Quick runbook snippet: ```# if error spike
if error_rate > 5% and p95 > 500ms:
  run ./scripts/traffic-cut.sh --reason "error_spike"
  run ./scripts/rollback-to v3.4.0
  alert #incidents @oncall
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Change-window lock applied by mel at 21:52 UTC. Freeze: true. Emergency unfreeze requires 2 SRE+PM approvals.

chris: I’ll be online for 30 mins after launch. If I cut traffic I’ll post exact command output.

mel: Small note — prefer to avoid full rollback if possible. Use targeted API-side throttles first (see runbook). But if state corruption suspected, full rollback.

ana: Quality monitor alert thresholds set: perplexity delta 0.25, hallucination rate > 2% triggers. I’ll post eval snapshot if any drift.

joel: Pushed a tiny doc update to release notes clarifying the migration of quant flags. No infra changes.

lisa: Smoke done (EU): login ok, generate OK, embeddings diff within tolerance. tagging thread: ✅

mel: Excellent. All pins confirmed: v3.4.1 pinned, canary healthy, locks in place. Rollback roster assigned. Everyone please ACK when you’re in position.

chris: ACK.

ana: ACK.

lisa: ACK.

joel: ACK.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary -> gradual traffic shift started at 22:00:30 UTC. 10% -> 50% over 10m. Monitoring hooks active.

sre-ops: I’ll keep this thread as the single source for rollback decisions. Ping me if anything odd.

mel: thank you all. I’ll close the quiet window note after 30m if no regressions. :pray:
